name: Arctic Lowlands and Arctic Coastal Plain

geo.extent: Southern Arctic Archipelago, Foxe Basin, Boothia, Victoria Island, Arctic coast and Mackenzie Delta

description: The low plateaus and plains of the southern and central Arctic Archipelago (Lancaster Plateau, Foxe Plain, Boothia Plain, Victoria Lowland, Shaler Mountains) and the Arctic Coastal Plain from Meighen Island to Alaska, including the Mackenzie Delta with its channels, lakes and pingos. Treeless tundra on continuous permafrost.

subregions: Arctic Coastal Plain (Island Coastal Plain, Mackenzie Delta, Yukon Coastal Plain)
ecozones_named_in_source: Northern Arctic (herb-lichen tundra; very cold, dry; continuous permafrost)
Southern Arctic (shrub-herb tundra; cold, dry; continuous permafrost)
attributes.elevation_note: Lancaster Plateau slopes from about 770 m on southern Ellesmere Island to 300–600 m on Somerset Island and the Brodeur Peninsula

sources.title: The Atlas of Canada – Physiographic Regions of Canada (map 1254A compiled by H.S. Bostock, 1967, with descriptive text)
Table 1.4 Biophysical characteristics of terrestrial ecozones (Human Activity and the Environment 2009, archived; from the National Ecological Framework / Wiken et al. 1996)

limitations: Physiographic description summarised from the Atlas of Canada; the map dates from 1967 (Bostock) and boundaries are generalised at 1:5 million. Lat/lon not given because the record describes an extensive region, not a point.
